artifacts.summary: Confirms the two live C16 unusedArguments findings in LadderPump.lean by a guarded runLinter run, establishes that the in-source @[nolint] + nolint-attribute-allowlist.txt route has superseded the cited nolints.json precedent, and recommends an asymmetric disposition: remove the two dead instance binders from exists_idleSpliced_ladderPath (zero consumers, body needs no instance) and exempt exists_idleTypeBlock_of_budget_le_run's hg (removal would relocate the finding into sibling-owned LadderWindow.lean), at a net-zero line delta to avoid the five-file generated cascade into concurrent task 918's territory.

memory_candidates.title: Batteries env_linter findings are unreachable by set_option linter.*
memory_candidates.content: A Batteries @[env_linter] such as unusedArguments runs post-hoc over an IMPORTED environment (scripts/runLinter.lean calls importModules then lintCore), so no in-source `set_option linter.X false in` is in scope when it runs. Only two things reach it: the `@[nolint X]` attribute (filtered by shouldBeLinted in Frontend.lean) and scripts/nolints.json (decls.erase, per-declaration not per-argument). A declaration can therefore carry a scoped set_option with a stated reason and still fail the C16 gate.

memory_candidates.title: Run the relocation test before removing a dead binder
memory_candidates.content: Before clearing an unusedArguments finding by deleting the argument, grep for the declaration's consumers. If a consumer's only use of its OWN same-named hypothesis is passing it through, deleting the binder makes the consumer's hypothesis dead and relocates the finding one layer up instead of clearing it -- and the new site may be in another task's file_scope. Conversely, a declaration with zero term-level consumers whose body requires no instance can have instance-implicit binders removed as a pure generalization, with no call site able to break.

memory_candidates.title: A net .lean line-count change is never a one-file commit here
memory_candidates.content: Any NET line-count change to a file under FormalSystem/ fans out to typst/generated/status.typ (typst-sync-check.sh Check 2, a pre-commit hook) and to every aggregator README inventory block above the file (check-module-invariants.sh INV group). Comment-only edits count. Sizing an edit to a net delta of zero avoids both cascades entirely -- decisive when the generated surfaces sit in a concurrent sibling's declared file_scope. scripts/ is NOT line-counted, so long-form justifications belong in a scripts/ allowlist rather than at the declaration site.
